name: Cafe Suspiro
address: 1246 Folsom St, San Francisco, CA 94103, USA
reviews:
Organic food options!!

Love the vibe at Suspiro with vintage records and tapes! Definitely worth a trip. Lots of o80’s memories in there. Great tasting coffee with some tasty snacks thrown in for good measure. They had a decently diverse selection of foods and snacks that even included an organic salad.

Definitely check Suspiro out!

“This warm and welcoming coffee shop is a gem that makes San Francisco feel even better. friendly barista, cozy atmosphere, and the coffee and pastries are absolutely delicious. Music is great! Highly recommend stopping by!”
Best coffee in soma. Been coming for years
The coffee is locally roasted, and they sell records, books and art. There’s a great selection of local authors! Best vibes per square foot in SoMa.

Great little coffee shop, very friendly. I stopped by before a meeting and got an oat milk latte and a mini-banana loaf. Everything was so tasty. It was the end of the day so there weren’t as many pastry options compared with earlier in the day, but I still found everything delicious. The person (owner?) working the shop was conversational and friendly. I don’t get here as often as I’d like, but I’ve had a great experience every time. The seating is pretty limited, but per my experience, folks are cool about sharing table space. The music is eclectic and I loved every beat I heard while I was there. I recommend!

name: Carlin's Cafe
address: 298 Valencia St, San Francisco, CA 94103, USA
reviews: Nick you are a hero!!! Definitely will trust a barista that risks his life to protect his customer!! And kudos for everybody that helps❤️

I made an order today at this location for pickup via TooGoodToGo (a great app for getting leftovers / unsold goods at end of day). When I arrived to pick up, the door was locked, and the staff kept ducking behind the counter (literally ducking behind it) to “hide” from the people outside coming to pick up.

Then when I left, they knocked on the window to get me to turn around and took my photo. All during their open hours (15 minutes before close). If you check my review history, I’m more of a positive review person and have worked many years in customer service. But what?? This was very weird, and it was super invasive to take my photo when all I did was make confused faces and wave my phone in the air like I was trying to communicate that I had a pick up. Would have had no issue if they’d just told me they couldn’t fulfill my order.
Love the atmosphere. Customer service is top notch. I definitely feel safe and accepted here and the food is amazing! Give them your business if you're looking for great food and service.

If I could contact Nick myself I would but this is the only way I know how. The video footage of you being an absolute hero was so inspiring. Going to sign up to some wrestling courses since watching. Glad people like you exist. Love from Canada, and will be coming to grab food when I next visit SF.
Here to praise Nick for thwarting the robbery of a customer. Good job dude! Can’t wait to support this shop next time I’m in the neighborhood.

name: LOQUAT
address: 198 Gough St, San Francisco, CA 94102, USA
reviews:
I have been meaning to visit Loquat for a while now and finally did this weekend.

I got their salted chocolate babka, and, oh my, it was amazing - a little crunchy, soft and chocolatey dream! Just for that I would rank this place 5 and go back to it again and again.

Coffee was okay, not the best one in town.

My boyfriend got a borek sandwich, which was ok as well but we won't get it again. We also had a pistachio cake but it was very weak.

The place was cute, good for dates since it was not too loud. Definitely, not a bakery where you can pull up your laptop.

The staff were nice and pleasant.

Down in Hayes Valley a gem of a
Bakery/coffee place with pastries from the Jewish diaspora. The Bourekas are flaky and light filled with savory fillings, I loved the kaboucha squash and toma cheese. The chocolate babka was delish. I went on a weekday and avoided the long weekend lines. Service is friendly, the vibe is eclectic, Bohemianish, loved it.

Came for the chocolate babka and it was divine. Buttery, chocolatey and flaky. Coffee is medium roast so a bit sour if you like 2nd / 3rd wave. Very friendly and helpful staff. Menu is full of delicious sweet and savory treats. Coming back!

Best tart I have ever had in my life!
살면서 먹은 타르트 중 가장 맛있었어요!

I had a lemon rosemary tart with coffee.
The tart was perfectly balanced with just the right amount of tang and zest. Not too sweet and the dallop of cream on top was a perfect finish. Coffee was okay and was nice to have with the treat.

I met a friend here and we tried some pastries — everything was so fresh and delicious that I can’t wait to go back and eat my way thru their menu.
It’s a small space with limited seating but people move in and out pretty quickly. Every time they pull something out of the oven it smells divine!

name: Blue Bottle Coffee
address: 315 Linden St, San Francisco, CA 94102, USA
reviews: Wonderful taste for coffee, unique taste and smell for ones that are very used to starbucks, a much better alternative to regulars., doesn't have a proper place to dine in but there are a couple of benches outside., its in a very smaller street so park on the near by roadside (have decent paid parking spots).
The first Blue Bottle Coffee! It’s wonderful to get a hot coffee and pastry in a chilling winter afternoon.

Cute kiosk spot but, as with all their locations recently, expect a long wait after ordering. At $6.25 (plus tip) for a capp, I’d expect more consistency in the quality. Both the shot & milk have both been mid on recent visits.

Their first brick and mortar location!
They are becoming famous in Japan among coffee enthusiasts (I’m not one of them) and I went there so that I have something to talk about.  Didn’t know much about them but their coffee was delicious!!
I had winter blend, my friend got Nola or spiced nola.  Both were surprisingly good, no wonder they are popular!

[4.5 / 5.0]

Nested in a tiny street in Hayes Valley, this blue bottle is truly something special.

Open-garage style interior with no actual seats, but it offers a truly unique blue bottle experience.

Would recommend for both locals and tourists.

name: Ritual Coffee Roasters
address: 432b Octavia St, San Francisco, CA 94102, USA
reviews: I walked for over 30 minutes to come here to get a pour over and chill by the park. After trying to order the barista said “we can’t make one because it’ll take too long”. Pretty wild lol why offer the drink on your menu if you don’t want to make it? I’ve never had this happen at any coffee shop in my life, pretty big waste of time. I don’t think it’s fair to decline a drink just because you don’t feel like making it.

Great location in Hayes, great vibe, you can get your coffee and walk around the neighborhood. But the coffee itself is nothing special for the hype. It was a bit overpriced. I got a Shakerato and it was just an iced latte with a marketing touch.
Great place for coffee in near city hall.  The staffs are very friendly and I enjoy the outdoor atmosphere.  It is kind of small though.

This coffee isn’t cheap. It’s $5 for a drip. In LA I can get incredible organic flavorful drip for $3.25 & a free refill. Why no free refill? & if your $7 pour over is tasteless. Very awkward to return… so you’re stuck for $7. Customer service varies a lot. Many times I feel disappointed.

Try and avoid the weekends and have no wait time to enjoy a San Francisco classic. Great coffee in a great little spot. They truly know what is a long black which is a nice surprise. They normally have tasters of the chocolate which pretty much entices you to buy a bar. You can walk across the way and enjoy the coffee on a nice patch of grass.

name: Four Barrel Coffee
address: 375 Valencia St, San Francisco, CA 94103, USA
reviews: I’ve heard of this coffee shop for a long time. When you walked in, you will just get done by their roof and how they decorate the environment. There were plenty of people, but because of these space it feels relaxing. If you walk towards the end, there is a person actually roasting the coffee and it was very cool. We won one day we’re very busy, but they still serve us pretty fast. Their coffee was very unique and it has like a nut taste in their coffee bean. This is the best coffee shop I’ve ever been in SF.

If you’re a fan of good  coffee, Four Barrel is definitely worth a visit. Their cappuccino hits the mark with a perfect balance of rich espresso and silky foam, making it a smooth, flavorful pick-me-up. The pastries are equally impressive—fresh, flaky, and just the right amount of sweetness to complement your coffee. Whether you’re there to catch up with a friend or just enjoy a solo moment, the vibe is relaxed and inviting. Four Barrel’s commitment to quality coffee and tasty treats makes it a standout spot for any coffee lover!

I LOVE that you can get a $0.50 discount for bringing your own mug; go sustainability.

I got the hot chocolate and really appreciated the bitterness that prevented the drink from being overly sweet

Great coffee with an in house roast (a little too dark for my taste but I guess you can choose different beans if you ask?). You can see them roast the beans in the back and the entire cafe smells like fresh roasted coffee! Would highly recommend!
Excellent café latte, the donut has a weird spice that I didn’t like. Doggy friendly and nice cafe in the mission area.

name: Sextant Coffee Roasters
address: 1415 Folsom St, San Francisco, CA 94103, USA
reviews:
Great for grab-and-go kinda orders.
Friendly staff.

Not a lot of space if you want to grab a table and enjoy your coffee in peace: which is just and observation, not a complaint.

First time here.  I pass it all the time and  always tell myself I need to try it out.   Finally,  I made an effort to visit.

Parking on this busy street wasn't bad with motorcycle.  I like the decor.  Very clean and efficient looking.  Although I'm not a fan of using a touch screen to order.   Seems so cold and unfriendly.
I totally understand the reasoning.  Requires less employees.... generates data.... accounting?

The coffee was delicious.   The coffee mug was the best I've experienced.   Weird but it made a huge difference.

I'll come back!

Highly rated for a reason. Great coffee and great service. We really enjoyed the organic food options. Indoor space is very nice with lots of room to sit and work. The patio outside is very nice as well.

Really great coffee!

I loved the balance flavors of coffee in this place. Coffee is perfectly creamy with right amount of bitterness. Tried their latte, cappuccino and mushroom croissant. Loved them all.
If you are in the neighborhood, you need to try this place for sure!

Ambience is excellent with indoor and outdoor seating. Friendly staff.

As a Melbourne local I have very high expectations for coffee, and coming into America, I was definitely nervous! When I Googled coffee shops close to my hotel, Sextant came up and I was not disappointed.
On my way out for a drive I stopped by for a cold brew and Morning Bun which were both delicious (thank god).
A really nice selection of kombuchas and other cold drinks as well.
Cute warehouse-y location and was nice and quiet given 9am on a Sunday!

name: Peet's Coffee
address: 1400 Mission St Suite 130, San Francisco, CA 94102, USA
reviews: In my opinion the most beautiful Peets in SF. The team were so nice and made the adjustments to my cappuccino exactly how I wanted. The only problem is they should have a security considering the area. But as far as the team and coffe I highly recommend
I like coming to Peet's here. It's in the middle of the mix but it is maintaining dignity. I like the oatmilk latte. The bathroom is clean. They are friendly.

Came in ordered a , caramel Frappuccino a  hot chocolate, and also ordered an oat frappuccino with no coffee.  The service is very quick with hardly no queue, the drinks  taste fantastic and ice cold especially given the warm weather!  Plenty available seating available inside.  Central area location .

Doing the best they can considering the horrific conditions outside. Homeless doing drugs, directly outside the door. Employees are wonderful. The coffee is great… it’s nice to have somewhere safe to sit down and relax after walking through the mission and being completely disgusted by the conditions of this city.

One of the best places to camp out and work remotely! Good Wifi, good taste of music selection, very very friendly staff. The only thing to consider is that every now and then some homeless/drugged people walk in to take a rest. But if that doesn’t bother you (like me), then this is a really great place. I love the communal table. It is so ridiculously gigantic to spread out all your stuff.

name: La Boulangerie de San Francisco
address: 500 Hayes St, San Francisco, CA 94102, USA
reviews: I was a tad bit disappointed with the croissant I had here. It wasn’t very flakey. I had the coconut ice latte wasn’t my cup of tea but still love the iconic bakery in sf a very relaxing place to grab a bite
Raspberry pistachio croissant $6(outer has pistachio, inside has raspberry filling) is delicious, no AC, free cold water
Latte and Croissant tastes great. The only thing makes it less great is some wooden furniture feel quite old and outdated

I still remember when they sold all 23 of these restaurants to Starbucks for $100 million in 2012….. just to sell it back to the former owner 3 years later… and now in 2025 for only 3 locations to still remain. Anybody who gets the better, in a business deal, of union busting POS Howard Schultz is a winner in my book. Food was so so, service very efficient but kinda soulless…. Atmosphere unforgivably too hipster/ influencer/ purple hair gen z for my liking…. Nonetheless glad to see that this place is thriving 12 years after Starbucks couldn’t find a way to make gourmet cuisine into fast food/ ultra processed crap. Cheers!

Lovely Boulangerie located on Hayes Street

Fresh food served by friendly welcoming staff

Ordered the quiche Lorraine and a latte
Great prices

Hot and well presented

Lovely selection of pastries
Coffees
Hot and cold sandwiches
Healthy tasty salad

Indoor and outdoors eating

Clean store great to catch up with friends or just on your own

Open 7 days a week
07:00-17:00

Give it a try you won’t be disappointed

name: Blue Bottle Coffee
address: 55 S Van Ness Ave, San Francisco, CA 94103, USA
reviews: Terrible experience with the lady barista in green highlights this morning 7/19 around 9am. she was INCREDIBLY rude to me and my friend. happy to share more details if required
Still too expensive for no reason.. And not the best service.. I don't get it you pay the price and we serve you as you get it for free 😂 locals coffee are way better

I was excited to come inside the Blue Bottle Coffee shop today. They have specialty drinks that aren't available at most other places. The price points are lofty. I would say it's worth it. The drink I chose was iced and shaken, coffee sweetened with vanilla and chicory syrup. The Shakerato, did not disappoint. Gave me a proper jolt.

I also ordered a (fun-sized) $3 blondie. Pretty small. Made with brown butter. Yummy! It’s safe to say that you don't get a lot of bang for your buck here. The iced coffee I ordered was $8, for a 12 ounce cup. The items here are all costly. Prepare to spend more than was likely expected.

The baked goods (which included croissants, cookies, muffins, etc) looked so fresh and enticing. Overall, I like the atmosphere, tasty food and drink selections, and the congenial baristas. I will come back for more.
Excellent service and delicious coffee. The space is super clean and there are plenty of tables with plugs. I worked there for a couple of hours.
All of the staffs are super nice and proffesional! Love the coffee too!
